description: This file defines the EmbedTokenParser class within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'embed' tags in Twig templates. It extends IncludeTokenParser to handle embedding of templates with the ability to inject parent template tokens and manage embedding logic.

classes.name: EmbedTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending IncludeTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'embed' tags in Twig templates to embed templates with optional parent template overrides.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'embed' tag, processes the parent template and inner module, and returns an EmbedNode representing the embedded template in the parse tree.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines whether the current token indicates the end of an embed block, specifically looking for 'endembed'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'embed'.
